entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The morning sun streamed through th..."
entries.dialogueText: The morning sun streamed through the windows of my chambers as I slowly opened my eyes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita was standing by the bedside...."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita was standing by the bedside. She had an unusually intense expression on her face.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is something wrong, my wife?""
entries.dialogueText: "Is something wrong, my wife?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What is it?""
entries.dialogueText: "What is it?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Can't we sleep in a little longer?..."
entries.dialogueText: "Can't we sleep in a little longer? It's not like I have a government to run anymore."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Can't we sleep in a little longer?""
entries.dialogueText: "Can't we sleep in a little longer?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She hesitated nervously."
entries.dialogueText: She hesitated nervously.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Your Maj-- Romus...""
entries.dialogueText: "Your Maj-- Romus..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""There's something I need to tell y..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's something I need to tell you."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I think I'm pregnant.""
entries.dialogueText: "I think I'm pregnant."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What do you mean, you *think*? Hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "What do you mean, you *think*? Haven't you been to the doctor yet?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What?! Since when?""
entries.dialogueText: "What?! Since when?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Praise the Lord!""
entries.dialogueText: "Praise the Lord!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is it a boy?""
entries.dialogueText: "Is it a boy?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I don't know. I don't even know ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know. I don't even know how far along I am."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We shouldn't celebrate yet. Nothin..."
entries.dialogueText: "We shouldn't celebrate yet. Nothing is certain."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""A month or two, maybe?""
entries.dialogueText: "A month or two, maybe?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""No, not yet.""
entries.dialogueText: "No, not yet."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""And with everything that's happene..."
entries.dialogueText: "And with everything that's happened to Her Highness-- Vina..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Time's been a blur since the war b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Time's been a blur since the war began. I thought I was throwing up from nerves."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She swallowed."
entries.dialogueText: She swallowed.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I wasn't even sure how you would t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wasn't even sure how you would take the news."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We've had so many security issues..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've had so many security issues lately. I thought I was throwing up from nerves."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""And then after everything with the..."
entries.dialogueText: "And then after everything with the General-- Father..."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Our overthrow in Zille was such a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our overthrow in Zille was such a blur. I thought I was throwing up from nerves."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We've both been so busy lately...""
entries.dialogueText: "We've both been so busy lately..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She hesitantly took my hand, restin..."
entries.dialogueText: She hesitantly took my hand, resting the other on her abdomen.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""From a purely pragmatic point of v..."
entries.dialogueText: "From a purely pragmatic point of view, this is perfect. I need a new successor now that Vina is gone."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""An heir and a spare. Just like I a..."
entries.dialogueText: "An heir and a spare. Just like I always wanted."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You needn't have worried, my love...."
entries.dialogueText: "You needn't have worried, my love. I'm the happiest man in the world right now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We have a challenging time ahead o..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have a challenging time ahead of us, that's for certain."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A new heir for our holy kingdom. G..."
entries.dialogueText: "A new heir for our holy kingdom. God has truly smiled upon us this day."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled and wrapped her arms aro..."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled and wrapped her arms around me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A puzzled frown formed on her face."
entries.dialogueText: A puzzled frown formed on her face.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Who's the spare?""
entries.dialogueText: "Who's the spare?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""She's not gone, you know.""
entries.dialogueText: "She's not gone, you know."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Whatever happens, we'll remember h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever happens, we'll remember her. But we're bringing new life into the world."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I love you, King Romus.""
entries.dialogueText: "I love you, King Romus."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We'll get through it together.""
entries.dialogueText: "We'll get through it together."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I love you, Queen Lucita.""
entries.dialogueText: "I love you, Queen Lucita."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I cherish and respect you deeply.""
entries.dialogueText: "I cherish and respect you deeply."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Halaita.""
entries.dialogueText: "Halaita."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know.""
entries.dialogueText: "I know."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And you'd never, ever do anything..."
entries.dialogueText: "And you'd never, ever do anything to betray me, right?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Will you come with me to the Palac..."
entries.dialogueText: "Will you come with me to the Palace doctors? I've put this off for long enough."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She kissed me on the forehead."
entries.dialogueText: She kissed me on the forehead.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Anyway...""
entries.dialogueText: "Anyway..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Wait. I want to tell Pabel first.""
entries.dialogueText: "Wait. I want to tell Pabel first."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Of course. What are we waiting for?""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course. What are we waiting for?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What do I tell Vina? Her inheritan..."
entries.dialogueText: "What do I tell Vina? Her inheritance might be at stake."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It'll still be a while before we f..."
entries.dialogueText: "It'll still be a while before we find out the sex. If it's a boy, I'm sure you'll find a way to let Her Highness down easily."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""First things first. Titus! Get in..."
entries.dialogueText: "First things first. Titus! Get in here! I'm going to be a father again!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My bodyguard entered the room. He c..."
entries.dialogueText: My bodyguard entered the room. He cast an eye over myself and Lucita, then reached out to shake my hand.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Congratulations, my king. You must..."
entries.dialogueText: "Congratulations, my king. You must be very proud."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I summoned my butler. He cautiously..."
entries.dialogueText: I summoned my butler. He cautiously regarded myself and Lucita as he stood in the doorway of my chambers.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Pabel! I'm going to be a father ag..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pabel! I'm going to be a father again!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lucita and I were married in secre..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lucita and I were married in secret, and now she's having my baby."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""What is it, Your Majesty?""
entries.dialogueText: "What is it, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""From now on, you're going to be bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "From now on, you're going to be butlering for three. King, queen and unborn heir."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Duchess Azaro and I are with child..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duchess Azaro and I are with child. You shall congratulate us at once."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A series of emotions passed across..."
entries.dialogueText: A series of emotions passed across his face as he absorbed this news. Finally, he reached out to shake my hand.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Congratulations to you both. You m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Congratulations to you both. You must be very proud."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As a gesture of gratitude for your..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a gesture of gratitude for your friendship and service to the Crown, I want you to be the godfather."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No time for chit-chat. We've got t..."
entries.dialogueText: "No time for chit-chat. We've got to get Lucita to the doctor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As a gesture of gratitude for your..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a gesture of gratitude for your service to the Crown, I want you to be the godfather."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No time for chit-chat. We've got t..."
entries.dialogueText: "No time for chit-chat. We've got to get Lucita to the doctor."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Right away.""
entries.dialogueText: "Right away."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw doubt in Lucita's eyes. Titus..."
entries.dialogueText: I saw doubt in Lucita's eyes. Titus knelt before me.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Nothing would honor me more.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing would honor me more."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a touch of sadness to his..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a touch of sadness to his smile.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Nothing would honor me more.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing would honor me more."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I hope all goes well.""
entries.dialogueText: "I hope all goes well."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus trailed a short distance behi..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus trailed a short distance behind as we walked down palace corridors towards the medical wing.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It's a good thing the Royal Counci..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a good thing the Royal Council petition hearings are coming up soon. We can announce the pregnancy, then reinstate General Taddeus straight away."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It's a good thing the Royal Counci..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a good thing the Royal Council petition hearings are coming up soon. We can announce the marriage and pregnancy, then reinstate General Taddeus straight away."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I want you as my security councilo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want you as my security councilor, Lucita. You're the best we've got."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, good thinking. Your father wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, good thinking. Your father will jump at the chance to serve."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your father is a disgrace to your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your father is a disgrace to your family, Lucita. He lost us Golden Shield."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can't think that far into the fu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't think that far into the future. Let's wait until we know more."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She blushed."
entries.dialogueText: She blushed.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""If I am, it's because I learned fr..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I am, it's because I learned from the best."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Now that you're forming the new Wr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now that you're forming the new Wruhecist Royal Council, we don't have a reason for secrecy any more."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I have to ask, Romus. Are you sure..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have to ask, Romus. Are you sure about these reforms?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We can announce the pregnancy righ..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can announce the pregnancy right away."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We can announce the marriage and p..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can announce the marriage and pregnancy right away."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""A poor choice of words, given his..."
entries.dialogueText: "A poor choice of words, given his condition. But you're right."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It's not *that* far into the futur..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not *that* far into the future, Romus. The months will pass in a heartbeat."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Give him a chance to prove himself.""
entries.dialogueText: "Give him a chance to prove himself."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In the medical wing, we were receiv..."
entries.dialogueText: In the medical wing, we were received immediately by a group of nurses.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm glad you don't think poorly of..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad you don't think poorly of the decision to dissolve the Council, by the way."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her face scrunched up."
entries.dialogueText: Her face scrunched up.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I am Queen Consort. I'm above the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am Queen Consort. I'm above the Council now anyway."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can't wait to spread the gospel..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't wait to spread the gospel of St. Wruhec with you by my side."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She half-smiled."
entries.dialogueText: She half-smiled.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Yes.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Kingdom may be changing. But t..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Kingdom may be changing. But the Royal Family will be forever."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She squeezed my hand."
entries.dialogueText: She squeezed my hand.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita was rushed into a side room..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita was rushed into a side room that contained Rizia's most state-of-the-art blood testing technology.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After two interminable hours in the..."
entries.dialogueText: After two interminable hours in the waiting room, the doctors called me in and told me the news.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was going to be a father again."
entries.dialogueText: I was going to be a father again.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "By the end of the year, a new heir..."
entries.dialogueText: By the end of the year, a new heir of Rizia would be born.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel was standing over my bed with..."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel was standing over my bed with the morning paper. He had an unusually intense expression on his face.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You don't need to bring me the pap..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't need to bring me the paper. You're not my butler anymore."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Read the paper to me in bed. The K..."
entries.dialogueText: "Read the paper to me in bed. The King commands you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let me guess. More bad news?""
entries.dialogueText: "Let me guess. More bad news?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Can't I sleep in a little longer?""
entries.dialogueText: "Can't I sleep in a little longer?"

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""In a bit. Let me show you somethin..."
entries.dialogueText: "In a bit. Let me show you something first."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""At once, sire.""
entries.dialogueText: "At once, sire."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel pulled back the covers and jo..."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel pulled back the covers and joined me in bed. He opened the newspaper and gestured at an article.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Rufus Gragg is at it again.""
entries.dialogueText: "Rufus Gragg is at it again."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""This is my copy of the Herald, tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is my copy of the Herald, thank you very much. But I wanted to show you something."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel sat down at the edge of the b..."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel sat down at the edge of the bed. He opened the newspaper and gestured at an article.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I was just perusing today's Herald..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was just perusing today's Herald when I saw this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Nobody cares what that old queen h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nobody cares what that old queen has to say."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What's he writing this time?""
entries.dialogueText: "What's he writing this time?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Remind me. Why haven't I fired him..."
entries.dialogueText: "Remind me. Why haven't I fired him yet?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""However bad he is, I'm sure the Vo..."
entries.dialogueText: "However bad he is, I'm sure the Voice is worse."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel cleared his throat and adopte..."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel cleared his throat and adopted an exaggerated Rumburgian accent.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""He's the only gossip columnist in..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's the only gossip columnist in the country. You can't deny his influence."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""He doesn't wield as much influence..."
entries.dialogueText: "He doesn't wield as much influence as he used to now that the press has opened up. But still..."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""His gossip has been harmless up to..."
entries.dialogueText: "His gossip has been harmless up to now. A useful distraction."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Actually, the Voice has intelligen..."
entries.dialogueText: "Actually, the Voice has intelligently recognized that there are more urgent things to worry about than the King's love life."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""'Who *is* Lord Pabel Adria? From h..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Who *is* Lord Pabel Adria? From humble beginnings as a groundskeeper's son to head butler to the Royal Family, this man now commands both an estate in Rizia Imperii and the exclusive attention of the King himself."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Since the Royal Wedding, Lord Adri..."
entries.dialogueText: "Since the Royal Wedding, Lord Adria has hardly strayed from His Majesty's side. They seem to share that rarest of treasures: a childhood friendship that has stretched well into middle age."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Though he keeps a low profile, Lor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Though he keeps a low profile, Lord Adria has been seen by His Majesty's side on numerous occasions. They seem to share that rarest of treasures: a childhood friendship that has stretched well into middle age."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""'Who *is* Pabel Adria? From humble..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Who *is* Pabel Adria? From humble beginnings as a groundskeeper's son to head butler to the Royal Family, this man now commands the exclusive attention of the King."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""His Majesty is hardly ever seen wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "His Majesty is hardly ever seen without Mr. Adria by his side. Not uncommon for a personal attendant, but these two seem to share that rarest of treasures: a childhood friendship that has stretched well into middle age."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Perhaps it is the depth of that sp..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps it is the depth of that special bond which has kept our King from seeking out a new Queen Consort."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Or could it be that he has already..."
entries.dialogueText: "Or could it be that he has already found one?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm used to such speculations abou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm used to such speculations about me. But they should leave you out of this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's as bad as it gets? Ha. It's..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's as bad as it gets? Ha. It's not like they can arrest us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If only you could be my Queen Cons..."
entries.dialogueText: "If only you could be my Queen Consort, Pabel."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""But this...""
entries.dialogueText: "But this..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My daughter might die, dammit! Can..."
entries.dialogueText: "My daughter might die, dammit! Can't a King get any privacy?"

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""No, they can't. Thanks to you.""
entries.dialogueText: "No, they can't. Thanks to you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He sighed wistfully."
entries.dialogueText: He sighed wistfully.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I got myself into this when I got..."
entries.dialogueText: "I got myself into this when I got myself into your trousers."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Apparently not.""
entries.dialogueText: "Apparently not."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""What if we could just be out in th..."
entries.dialogueText: "What if we could just be out in the open about us?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's true. My daughter's a prisone..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's true. My daughter's a prisoner. The worst thing that could ever happen to me has already happened."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""You told me you're planning on let..."
entries.dialogueText: "You told me you're planning on letting go of your power. What's the worst that could happen?"

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I mean it. What's the worst that c..."
entries.dialogueText: "I mean it. What's the worst that could happen?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll be usurped. Laughed off the t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll be usurped. Laughed off the throne. Perhaps even from within my own family."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're right. I am the king. If my..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right. I am the king. If my subjects love me, they'll love you as well."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina's got her heart set on being..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina's got her heart set on being queen. I don't want to do anything to jeopardize that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The entire world will know that th..."
entries.dialogueText: "The entire world will know that the King of Rizia enjoys the company of men."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My daughter ran away. It's been on..."
entries.dialogueText: "My daughter ran away. It's been one royal scandal after another."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""You'll be more famous than ever. B..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll be more famous than ever. But yes, not all of the attention will be positive."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I can't imagine how much pain you'..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't imagine how much pain you've been in."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Whether us going public will ease..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whether us going public will ease or compound that pain... I don't know, Rom. It's up to you."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""You being involved with a man won'..."
entries.dialogueText: "You being involved with a man won't disrupt the line of succession. It'd be worse if you married a woman and had a boy."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""It's up to you. But think of what..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's up to you. But think of what a relief it would be to stop hiding."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Well, precisely. What's one more?""
entries.dialogueText: "Well, precisely. What's one more?"

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Let's be real. Not all of them wil..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's be real. Not all of them will."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Is House Toras really so intoleran..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is House Toras really so intolerant? Don't answer that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let's test the waters first. We'll..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's test the waters first. We'll tell my mother."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is as out in the open as I'm..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is as out in the open as I'm willing to get, Pabel. We shall continue as we have been. For the rest of our lives, if we have to."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm having Rufus Gragg fired. My l..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm having Rufus Gragg fired. My love life shall remain private, and no speculation about it shall make it into the papers ever again."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Why not?""
entries.dialogueText: "Why not?"

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""All right. I understand.""
entries.dialogueText: "All right. I understand."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""But we can't go on forever like th..."
entries.dialogueText: "But we can't go on forever like this. Sooner or later, the truth will out."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He got up and smoothed out his suit..."
entries.dialogueText: He got up and smoothed out his suit.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""If you'll excuse me, I have an est..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you'll excuse me, I have an estate that needs tending to."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""If you'll excuse me, I have chores..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you'll excuse me, I have chores that need tending to."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He bowed and walked out."
entries.dialogueText: He bowed and walked out.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He nodded his assent."
entries.dialogueText: He nodded his assent.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""After our conversation at Vina's w..."
entries.dialogueText: "After our conversation at Vina's wedding, Madam Estela definitely suspects something."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""The Queen Mother doesn't miss a th..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Queen Mother doesn't miss a thing that goes on in this palace. She must suspect something already."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We left my chambers and crossed the..."
entries.dialogueText: We left my chambers and crossed the hall. I knocked on my mother's door.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She answered, still in her bathrobe..."
entries.dialogueText: She answered, still in her bathrobe.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""My goodness, son. What are you two..."
entries.dialogueText: "My goodness, son. What are you two doing here?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You should sit down, Mother.""
entries.dialogueText: "You should sit down, Mother."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Pabel and I have something to tell..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pabel and I have something to tell you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let's go to the balcony. I could u..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's go to the balcony. I could use a smoke."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We entered the room and sat on oppo..."
entries.dialogueText: We entered the room and sat on opposite sofas.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Starting early today, are we?""
entries.dialogueText: "Starting early today, are we?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We crossed the room and went onto t..."
entries.dialogueText: We crossed the room and went onto the balcony. Mother lit a cigarette and handed it to me.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Now. What is so urgent that you'd..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now. What is so urgent that you'd disturb an old lady's birthday preparations?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mother... I am a homosexual.""
entries.dialogueText: "Mother... I am a homosexual."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Pabel and I are in love. We have b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pabel and I are in love. We have been for a long time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This might come as a shock, but I..."
entries.dialogueText: "This might come as a shock, but I am attracted to men as well as women."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I risk bringing shame upon this fa..."
entries.dialogueText: "I risk bringing shame upon this family by loving a member of the same sex."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother was very quiet for a long..."
entries.dialogueText: My mother was very quiet for a long moment.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Then she burst out laughing."
entries.dialogueText: Then she burst out laughing.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Oh, darling. I know. I'm your moth..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, darling. I know. I'm your mother, after all."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""The question remains, though. What..."
entries.dialogueText: "The question remains, though. What exactly do you plan to do about it?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I've been waiting for this news si..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've been waiting for this news since you rolled out the rainbow carpet to homosexuals across the kingdom."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel gave a smile of relief."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel gave a smile of relief.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I want the world to know. We could..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want the world to know. We could set an example for millions."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We haven't decided yet.""
entries.dialogueText: "We haven't decided yet."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sooner or later, everyone will fin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sooner or later, everyone will find out. I should control the narrative by making an announcement."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her expression turned stern."
entries.dialogueText: Her expression turned stern.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Listen to me very carefully, Romus.""
entries.dialogueText: "Listen to me very carefully, Romus."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I didn't fully know what I was sig..."
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't fully know what I was signing up for when I married into House Toras. But I know now."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""A husband poisoned by a religious..."
entries.dialogueText: "A husband poisoned by a religious lunatic..."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""A husband known eternally as 'The..."
entries.dialogueText: "A husband known eternally as 'The Frail'..."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""A precious daughter-in-law taken b..."
entries.dialogueText: "A precious daughter-in-law taken before her time..."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""A nephew ousted in disgrace...""
entries.dialogueText: "A nephew ousted in disgrace..."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""His father humiliated to the point..."
entries.dialogueText: "His father humiliated to the point of resignation..."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""A granddaughter held hostage in a..."
entries.dialogueText: "A granddaughter held hostage in a war that should never have happened in the first place..."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""A granddaughter made miserable to..."
entries.dialogueText: "A granddaughter made miserable to the point of self-exile..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She pulled out a handkerchief and d..."
entries.dialogueText: She pulled out a handkerchief and dabbed at her eyes.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I love you, darling. But you can't..."
entries.dialogueText: "I love you, darling. But you can't bring more shame to this family. Especially not right before my birthday."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm surprised at you, Mother. I th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm surprised at you, Mother. I thought you'd support me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel nodded in agreement."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel nodded in agreement.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am sorry. But none of this was m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry. But none of this was my fault."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You started it! You seduced my fat..."
entries.dialogueText: "You started it! You seduced my father and brought our noble house to ruin."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I won't. I promise.""
entries.dialogueText: "I won't. I promise."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Seduced? Don't delude yourself.""
entries.dialogueText: "Seduced? Don't delude yourself."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""That makes no difference. You carr..."
entries.dialogueText: "That makes no difference. You carry the weight of your entire House on your shoulders."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""This is for your own good.""
entries.dialogueText: "This is for your own good."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""If you want to live openly with yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you want to live openly with your charming companion here, by all means, do so."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I do support you. This is for your..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do support you. This is for your own good."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Just... not with the crown on your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just... not with the crown on your head. Please."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Abdicate and live your truth. Or s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Abdicate and live your truth. Or stay in power and hide it. That's my advice."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel and I looked at each other, t..."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel and I looked at each other, then at my mother once more.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If I have to leave the throne to b..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I have to leave the throne to be with the man I love, I will. My work as King is not yet over, but I will take your advice seriously."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your true colors are showing. I re..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your true colors are showing. I refuse to give in to your bigotry. We will announce our love to the world."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You have made your point. As long..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have made your point. As long as I am king, this will be our secret."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She nodded in approval."
entries.dialogueText: She nodded in approval.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Good boy.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good boy."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Now, Lord Adria. Don't you have an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now, Lord Adria. Don't you have an estate to attend to?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Now, Mr. Adria. Don't you have cho..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now, Mr. Adria. Don't you have chores to attend to?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her jaw clenched."
entries.dialogueText: Her jaw clenched.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""You're making a mistake.""
entries.dialogueText: "You're making a mistake."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""But I won't be the one to stop you.""
entries.dialogueText: "But I won't be the one to stop you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel nodded. He looked shaken."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel nodded. He looked shaken.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Yes, madam. Sorry to trouble you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, madam. Sorry to trouble you."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""No problem at all.""
entries.dialogueText: "No problem at all."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She swiftly ushered us both out the..."
entries.dialogueText: She swiftly ushered us both out the door and closed it without another word.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""If you'll excuse me, I've got to p..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you'll excuse me, I've got to put my face on before breakfast."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""To add insult to injury, we lost Z..."
entries.dialogueText: "To add insult to injury, we lost Zille. If I may say so, dear... you had one job!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel nodded. He looked shaken."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel nodded. He looked shaken.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Sorry to trouble you, madam.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry to trouble you, madam."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Did Bruno kick you out of bed agai..."
entries.dialogueText: "Did Bruno kick you out of bed again? Sorry, he does that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""One moment. Bruno! You're going to..."
entries.dialogueText: "One moment. Bruno! You're going to be a big brother!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My dog hopped on the bed and licked..."
entries.dialogueText: My dog hopped on the bed and licked my face. Lucita scratched him behind the ears, then tugged my arm impatiently.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Shall we?""
entries.dialogueText: "Shall we?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""This explains a lot. Congratulatio..."
entries.dialogueText: "This explains a lot. Congratulations, my king."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Bruno hopped on the bed and licked..."
entries.dialogueText: Bruno hopped on the bed and licked Pabel's face. He sighed wistfully.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""So that's it? After everything, yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "So that's it? After everything, you would really step down for me?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel and I stood facing each other..."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel and I stood facing each other in the hallway.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If my reforms succeed, my power wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "If my reforms succeed, my power will be symbolic. Why not live out the rest of my days in peace?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've accomplished what I set out t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've accomplished what I set out to do. Things can only go downhill from here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have failed my kingdom anyway. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have failed my kingdom anyway. I don't deserve my crown."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It will be a relief, to be honest...."
entries.dialogueText: "It will be a relief, to be honest. Being king is hard."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm thinking about it. No promises..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm thinking about it. No promises yet."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""So that's it? We're going public?""
entries.dialogueText: "So that's it? We're going public?"

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I guess that's it, then.""
entries.dialogueText: "I guess that's it, then."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Madam Estela was right. I should b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Madam Estela was right. I should be going."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He rapidly turned away from me and..."
entries.dialogueText: He rapidly turned away from me and walked down the hall.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Homosexuality is legal. You're a l..."
entries.dialogueText: "Homosexuality is legal. You're a lord. There's nothing stopping us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Homosexuality is legal. There's no..."
entries.dialogueText: "Homosexuality is legal. There's nothing stopping us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Screw what my mother says. I refus..."
entries.dialogueText: "Screw what my mother says. I refuse to be ashamed of my identity."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'd rather not. But everyone will..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd rather not. But everyone will find out sooner or later. It's best to control the narrative."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""You're right.""
entries.dialogueText: "You're right."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He smirked."
entries.dialogueText: He smirked.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""That's the spirit.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's the spirit."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Don't be so hard on yourself.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't be so hard on yourself."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Why not, indeed?""
entries.dialogueText: "Why not, indeed?"

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Having served two of you, I won't..."
entries.dialogueText: "Having served two of you, I won't argue with that."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I understand.""
entries.dialogueText: "I understand."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I still wish Rizia were ready to b..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still wish Rizia were ready to be ruled by a King and a King Consort. But realistically... your mother has a point."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He placed his hand in mine and we w..."
entries.dialogueText: He placed his hand in mine and we walked back down the hall together.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I thought about Mother's words. Per..."
entries.dialogueText: I thought about Mother's words. Perhaps the time would have to come for me to end my reign.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But not just yet."
entries.dialogueText: But not just yet.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Shall we leak the news to Rufus Gr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Shall we leak the news to Rufus Gragg? If anyone deserves the scoop, he does."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Bruno hopped off the bed as Pabel s..."
entries.dialogueText: Bruno hopped off the bed as Pabel sat down. He opened the newspaper and gestured at an article.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel gently shoved Bruno aside, pu..."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel gently shoved Bruno aside, pulled back the covers and joined me in bed. He opened the newspaper and gestured at an article.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know your religion despises homo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know your religion despises homosexuality. But can't you make an exception for your son?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She glanced around her."
entries.dialogueText: She glanced around her.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""My religion -- whatever it may be..."
entries.dialogueText: "My religion -- whatever it may be -- has nothing to do with what I'm saying."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I suspect my reign won't last much..."
entries.dialogueText: "I suspect my reign won't last much longer anyway. Might as well go out with a bang."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I don't know what you're thinking,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know what you're thinking, but I draw the line at doing *that* in public."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No. In fact, I want him fired for..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. In fact, I want him fired for smearing my good name. Let's tell the main staff at the Herald."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No, let's give this to the Voice...."
entries.dialogueText: "No, let's give this to the Voice. That'll teach him for being such a busybody."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, let's. We'll make his career.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, let's. We'll make his career."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""As you wish.""
entries.dialogueText: "As you wish."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""If we're lucky, it'll make the fro..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we're lucky, it'll make the front page."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He placed his hand in mine. We walk..."
entries.dialogueText: He placed his hand in mine. We walked back down the hall together.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There is still no word about Vina...."
entries.dialogueText: "There is still no word about Vina. I may have to make the call at one point."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""His father found guilty of poisoni..."
entries.dialogueText: "His father found guilty of poisoning his own brother -- my husband..."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""A brother-in-law capable of fratri..."
entries.dialogueText: "A brother-in-law capable of fratricide..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I love you, Pabel. But I love bein..."
entries.dialogueText: "I love you, Pabel. But I love being king more."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Just give it a few more years. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just give it a few more years. The public will be ready for us someday."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You shouldn't be with me anymore,..."
entries.dialogueText: "You shouldn't be with me anymore, Pabel. Go meet someone else. Be free."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You heard my mother. My family has..."
entries.dialogueText: "You heard my mother. My family has been through enough."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you sure you don't want to wai..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you sure you don't want to wait until after Mother's birthday?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She scoffed."
entries.dialogueText: She scoffed.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""That's what you're concerned about..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's what you're concerned about? Come on, let's go."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""...And her husband, of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "...And her husband, of course."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""My family is reluctant enough to g..."
entries.dialogueText: "My family is reluctant enough to give up our power. If they know they've got a potential heir on the throne..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The monarchy's barely changing und..."
entries.dialogueText: "The monarchy's barely changing under the new constitution. The Azaros and everyone else have nothing to worry about."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But you'll convince them reform is..."
entries.dialogueText: "But you'll convince them reform is the right way to go. Yes?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The royal baby will be a Toras, an..."
entries.dialogueText: "The royal baby will be a Toras, anyway. Not an Azaro."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""In name only. I'll teach him to sw..."
entries.dialogueText: "In name only. I'll teach him to swordfight before he can even walk."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I'll try my best. But not if the r..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll try my best. But not if the reforms go directly against their interests. You have to understand that."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""My father will have to be the judg..."
entries.dialogueText: "My father will have to be the judge of that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If they're truly concerned for the..."
entries.dialogueText: "If they're truly concerned for the safety of their unborn heir, they'll agree to these changes."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She swallowed."
entries.dialogueText: She swallowed.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""All right.""
entries.dialogueText: "All right."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Rizian Royal Family shall stil..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Rizian Royal Family shall still reign, my dear. The Azaros will be lucky to be part of it."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""My father's going to want more tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "My father's going to want more than that. And I'm not sure he can be convinced otherwise."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""And you've been disappearing off G..."
entries.dialogueText: "And you've been disappearing off God knows where..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With everything that's been going..."
entries.dialogueText: "With everything that's been going on, you'd think he'd give it a rest."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Gossip is a welcome distraction fr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Gossip is a welcome distraction from times of turmoil. I get it. But listen..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It gladdens my heart that so many..."
entries.dialogueText: "It gladdens my heart that so many Rizians like us are now able to live freely. But it's never going to be us, Pabel. Not as long as I am King."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked at me for a moment, crest..."
entries.dialogueText: He looked at me for a moment, crestfallen, then embraced me tightly.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I always thought, maybe someday...""
entries.dialogueText: "I always thought, maybe someday..."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""But you're right. You're a royal...."
entries.dialogueText: "But you're right. You're a royal. Your life is not entirely yours to lead."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It isn't. But I still want to shar..."
entries.dialogueText: "It isn't. But I still want to share it with you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I may not rule Rizia forever. 'Som..."
entries.dialogueText: "I may not rule Rizia forever. 'Someday' could come sooner than you think."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Rom. I could never ask you to give..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rom. I could never ask you to give up the throne for me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is. I'm just a coward.""
entries.dialogueText: "It is. I'm just a coward."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""You're my coward.""
entries.dialogueText: "You're my coward."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Bi mare volu, un oxit solu.""
entries.dialogueText: "Bi mare volu, un oxit solu."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What about your life? You deserve..."
entries.dialogueText: "What about your life? You deserve to be with someone who can show you off like the jewel you are."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""Touching, Rom. But I can't give yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Touching, Rom. But I can't give you up that easily."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He pulled back and traced the scar..."
entries.dialogueText: He pulled back and traced the scar on my chest with his fingers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He pulled back and traced my bare c..."
entries.dialogueText: He pulled back and traced my bare collarbone with his fingers.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I'll see you at the Queen Mother's..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll see you at the Queen Mother's birthday. As an esteemed guest, of course."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I should get going. Lots to do bef..."
entries.dialogueText: "I should get going. Lots to do before the Queen Mother's birthday."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He kissed me, bowed and walked out."
entries.dialogueText: He kissed me, bowed and walked out.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What do you think we should do?""
entries.dialogueText: "What do you think we should do?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sorry, Mother. But I can't kee..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, Mother. But I can't keep hiding who I am. The birthday party will be our debut as a couple."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He smiled sadly and kissed me on th..."
entries.dialogueText: He smiled sadly and kissed me on the cheek.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I've waited this long. A few more..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've waited this long. A few more years won't hurt."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He smiled sadly and kissed me on th..."
entries.dialogueText: He smiled sadly and kissed me on the cheek.

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""You say that as if loving you were..."
entries.dialogueText: "You say that as if loving you were a choice."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I'll see you at the Queen Mother's..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll see you at the Queen Mother's birthday. As an esteemed guest, of course."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I should get going. Lots to do bef..."
entries.dialogueText: "I should get going. Lots to do before the Queen Mother's birthday."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He kissed me again, bowed and walke..."
entries.dialogueText: He kissed me again, bowed and walked away.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Trust me. After my mother's birthd..."
entries.dialogueText: "Trust me. After my mother's birthday party, nobody will be talking about our relationship anymore."

entries.speaker: Pabel Adria
entries.title: Pabel Adria: ""I don't know if I like the sound o..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know if I like the sound of that... But all right."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I was waiting for her to re-emer..."
entries.dialogueText: As I was waiting for her to re-emerge, Titus whispered in my ear.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Your Majesty, do you still want to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, do you still want to go through with the plans we talked about? As it stands, you would be putting the Queen Consort -- and your own unborn child -- in great danger."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know, but I have no choice. We'r..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know, but I have no choice. We're doing this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're right. We won't strike agai..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right. We won't strike against House Azaro that night."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will make sure nothing happens t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will make sure nothing happens to either of them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're right. Let's call off the p..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right. Let's call off the plan. It's too risky."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus gave a grim nod."
entries.dialogueText: Titus gave a grim nod.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""As you wish, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "As you wish, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I suppose even in her condition, L..."
entries.dialogueText: "I suppose even in her condition, Lucita is more than capable of protecting herself."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus nodded quickly."
entries.dialogueText: Titus nodded quickly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus gave a furtive sigh of relief..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus gave a furtive sigh of relief.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Bruno trailed a short distance behi..."
entries.dialogueText: Bruno trailed a short distance behind as we walked down palace corridors towards the medical wing.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Pabel trailed a short distance behi..."
entries.dialogueText: Pabel trailed a short distance behind as we walked down palace corridors towards the medical wing.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We walked down palace corridors tow..."
entries.dialogueText: We walked down palace corridors towards the medical wing.
